clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope — Requirements for aggregates, crushed or uncrushed, derived from natural sources for use in the production of structural concrete including mass concrete works.

clauses.title: Aggregates shall consist of naturally occurring
clauses.text: 2.1 Aggregates shall consist of naturally occurring stones, gravel and sand, and shall be hard, strong, dense, durable, clear and free from veins, adherent coating and injurious amounts of disintegrated pieces and deleterious substances.

clauses.title: Deleterious Materials
clauses.text: 2.2 Deleterious Materials — Aggregates shall not contain harmful materials, such as pyrites, laminated material, alkali, seashells, and organic impurities and those which may attack the reinforcement,  in  excess of   the  limits given in Table 1 of the standard. Aggargates shall not be chemically reactive with alkalis of cement.

clauses.title: Aggregate crushing value shall
clauses.text: 2.3 Aggregate crushing value shall not exceed 30 percent for concrete for wearing surfaces (such as runways and roads) and 45 percent for other concrete.

clauses.title: Aggregate impact value (alternative
clauses.text: 2.4 Aggregate impact value (alternative to 2.3) shall not exceed 30 percent by weight for concrere for wearing surface and 45 percent by weight for other concrete.

clauses.title: Aggregate abrasion value shall
clauses.text: 2.5 Aggregate abrasion value shall not exceed 30 percent for concrete for wearing surfaces and 50 percent for other concrete.

clauses.title: Soundness (for concrete liable
clauses.text: 2.6 Soundness (for concrete liable to be exposed to frost action) — Coarse and fine aggregates shall pass a sodium or magnesium sulphate accelerated soundness test specified in IS : 2386 (Part V) 1963, for concrete liable to be exposed to the action of frost.
